title: REQ · Six-layer render order and injected render context exist
summary: LAYER_ORDER, layerDepth and a RenderContext interface are available
description: Context: layerSchema lists the six layers but nothing orders them for rendering. Desired behavior: a layers module exports LAYER_ORDER and layerDepth, and a renderContext module exports RenderContext, RenderSpriteSpec and RenderHandle interfaces. Expected result: depth is monotonic in layer order and unknown layers fall back to objects. Why: gives every entity a single rendering-order source.
acceptance_criteria: Given LAYER_ORDER, when layerDepth is called for each layer, then depths are strictly increasing in order
Given an undefined or unknown layer string, when layerDepth is called, then it returns the objects depth
